अष्टमक: अष्टमक अष्टम + क, adj. Eighth, Yājñ. 2, 244.
अष्टा: अष्टा अष्टा, a substitute of अष्टन् in the former part of many comp. words, especially before numerals, e. g. अष्टा -दशन्, Eighteen.
अष्टादश: अष्टादश अष्टा-दश, ord. num., f. शी, Eighteenth, Chr. 51.
अष्टादशन्: अष्टादशन् अष्टा-दशन्, card. num. adj. Eighteen, Man. 8, 3. -- Cf. Lat. octodecim.
अष्टापद: अष्टापद अष्टा-पद।  I. n. A board for draughts, dice, etc., Hariv. 6752.  II. m. and n. Gold, Kumāras, 7, 10.
अष्टापाद्य: अष्टापाद्य अष्टापाद्य, i. e. अष्टा -पाद + य, adj. Eight-fold, Man. 8, 337.
अष्ट्रा: अष्ट्रा अष्ट्रा, i. e. अश् + त्र (vb. शो, cf. Lat. incitare), f. A goad.
अष्ठीला: अष्ठीला अष्ठीला (probably from अस्थि), f.  1. A kernel, MBh. 3, 10629.  2. A ball, MBh. 1, 4494.
अस्: 1. अस् अस्, ii. 2, Par. (Ātm. when combined with वि-अति and as auxiliary vb.; e. g. सृष्टाः स्मके, MBh. 13, 13).  1. To exist, Bhag. 2, 12.  2. To be, Man. 1, 5; with an adv., MBh. 3, 4041; with participles, Man. 8, 94. अस्ति, So it is, Śāk. 14, 16. अस्ति, Once, Pañc. 132, 22. With न, Not, it implies very often ‘to be lost,’ e. g. MBh. 3, 10284.  3. With a gen. To belong. कस्यासि, Whose are you, Nal. 12, 118. सन्ति मे, I have, Man. 8, 87. तवास्मि, I am thy captive, Man. 7, 91.  4. With a dat. To suffice, Man. 11, 85.  5. With a loc. or with प्रति, To be affected against, Śāk. 17, 13; 14. सन्त्, participle of the present (cf. Lat. præ-sens), 1. Being, Hit. i. d. 75. 2. Being in the true sense of the word, Right, Bhāṣāp. 138. 3. Virtuous, Chr. 8, 22. 4. Steady, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 10. 5. Venerable, Rājat. 5, 79. 6. Excellent, Kir. 5, 9. fem. सती, A virtuous wife, Lass. 41, 11.  Comp. महा-सती, a very virtuous wife, Pañc. 38, 12. n. सत्, Entity, Man. 1, 11. superl. सत् + तम, adj., f. मा, Most excellent. In comp. words of the Khar-madhār. class it forms the latter part, e. g. द्विज-सत्तम, 1. A Brāhmaṇa, Man. 1, 33. 2. A most excellent Brāh-maṇa, Chr. 15, 30. ब्राह्मण-, m. Chr. 22, 15; भरत-, 25, 55; भारत-, 40, 17; भृगु-, 45, 11; मृग-, Rām. 3, 49, 25; रथ-, Chr. 63, 64; राजसत्तम, i. e. राजन्-, 53, 5.  -- Comp. अ-सन्त्, adj. wick-ed, Pañc. i. d. 182; heretic, Man. 11, 65. f. अ-सती, an unchaste woman, Pañc. 185, 15. अ-सत्, n. non-entity, Man. 1, 11. -- With the prepositions व्यति वि-अति, Ātm. To outweigh, Bhaṭṭa. 2, 35. -- With आविस् आविस्, To be visible, to appear, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 17 (corr. आविर् आसीत्).  -- With उप उप, To be near, Chr. 12, 2. -- With प्रादुस् प्रादुस्,  1. To be con-spicuous, Man. 1, 6.  2. To appear, Chr. 13, 6.  3. To spring up, Chr. 31, 10.  -- Cf. εἰμί, e. g. ἐστί = अस्ति; Lat. sum, est; Goth. im, ist; A.S. ëom, is.

2. अस् अस्, i. 4, Par.  1. To throw, Rām. 2, 67, 18.  2. To leave, Kathās. 6, 141. Aor. आस्थम्, Ragh. 12, 23. Part. of the perf. pass. अस्त (असित, Rām. 4, 13, 54). -- With the prep. अति अति, To surpass, Rām. 2, 23, 37. -- With व्यति वि-अति, To cross, Man. 2, 72. --With अप अप।  1. To drive away, Amar. 2.  2. To put off, Nalod. 3, 8.  3. To lay aside, Rām. 2, 32, 30.  4. To leave, Pañc. Pr. d. 10. Absolutive अपास्य, Except, Hit. iii. d. 139. --With अभि अभि, also Ātm. Man. 4, 149; sometimes i. 1, Par. Man. 11, 106.  1. To discharge (an arrow), MBh. 1, 5497.  2. To do repeatedly; to repeat, Man. 2, 79.  3. To practise, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 1.  4. To study, Pañc. 244, 1. -- With उद् उद्।  1. To east upward, MBh. 3, 430.  2. To lift up, Śāk. 34, 1; to raise, Śiś. 9, 74. -- With पर्युद् परि -उद्, To heap round about, MBh. 2, 1805.  -- With व्युद् वि-उद्, To cast off, Bhag. 18, 51. -- With नि नि, also i. 1 Par. Man. 6, 46.  1. To cast down, Rām. 3, 58, 2; to put down, Chr. 27. 12.  2. To resign, Rām. 2, 46, 20.  3. To put on, Rām. 2, 28, 27; Daśak. in Chr. 189. 6.  4. To support, Śāk. d. 161.  5. To put in, Bhartṛ. 2, 77; to settle, Yājñ. 2, 186; to appoint, MBh. 12, 4336.  6. To intrust, Rām. 3, 51, 18.  -- Comp. partic. चित्र-न्यस्त, adj. painted, MBh. 9, 43. सु-न्यस्त, gracefully reposing, Rām. 5, 14, 23. Caus., to cause to put down, Chr. 43, 31. -- With उपनि उप-नि।  1. To put near, Rām. 4, 4, 17.  2. To intrust, MBh. 3, 11551.  3. To prove, Hit. 120, 5.  4. To hint, Śāk. 65, 15.  Comp. partic. अन्-उप-न्यस्त, unproved, Yājñ. 2, 19. -- With समुपनि सम्-उप-नि, To prove, Hit. 103, 3. -- With परिनि परि-नि, To stretch, Kathās. 6, 121. -- With प्रतिनि प्रति-नि, To put down for every one, Rām. 2, 40, 16. -- With विनि विनि,  1. To put off and down, Pañc. 230, 18.  2. To put down, Nal. 24, 45.  3. To divide, Rām. 1, 13, 28.  4. To direct, Rām. 2, 60, 7.  5. To put in, Pañc. 236, 9.  -- Comp. partic. सु-वि-न्यस्त, well ar-ranged, Rām. 5, 13, 37. -- With संनि सम्-नि,  1. To put down, MBh. 3, 16708.  2. To abandon, Man. 6, 95; to abandon all worldly concerns, i. e. to become an anchorite, Man. 6, 94.  3. To put together, Rām. 3, 35, 63.  4. To put on, MBh. 3, 740.  5. To intrust, Rām. 4, 28, 5. -- With निस् निस्,  1. To throw out, to expel, Śiś. 9, 62; Ṛt. 6, 23; Rām. 3, 75, 24.  2. To drive back, Rām. 3, 42, 42; to send back, Śiś, 9, 33.  3. To destroy, Hit. i. d. 63. -- With परा परा, To leave, Kir. 5, 27. -- With परि परि,  1. To spread, Kir. 5, 34.  2. To put around, MBh. 2, 1898.  3. To turn round, Kumāras. 3, 68.  4. To surround, Kumāras. 1, 45; to enchase, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 23.  5. To turn over, Man. 11, 183.  6. To turn away. Bhartṛ. 3, 29. --Caus. to cause to drop, Ragh. 13, 28.  -- With विपरि वि-परि, To invert, Mṛcch. 115, 4. -- With प्र प्र, To throw, Man. 11, 73. -- With वि वि,  1. To separate, Man. 7, 159; Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 3; to divide, MBh. 1, 4263; pf. विव्यास, MBh. 1, 2212, instead of व्या-स, as if the combined व्यस् was a simple vb. व्यस्त, different, Prab. 97, 19; MBh. 3, 17052. -- With सम् सम्, To unite, Man. 7, 57; Vedāntas. 205, 3. समस्त। 1. United, Man. 3, 85. 2. All, Rājat. 5, 62. 3. Whole, Pañc. 69, 15.  -- Comp. यावत्समस्त, i. e. यावन्त्-, large as it is, Pañc. 31, 17.
† 3. अस् अस्, i. 1, Par. Ātm.  1. To go.  2. To take.  3. To shine (v. r. अष्।)
असन: असन 2. अस् + अन।  I. n. Discharging (as arrows), Chr. 297, 21 = Rigv. i. 112, 21.  II. m. The name of a tree, Terminalia alata tomentosa, Rām. 2, 94, 8.  -- Comp. इषु-, n. a bow, Ragh. 11, 37. शर-, n. a bow.
असमञ्ज: असमञ्ज असमञ्ज and असमञ्जस् असमञ्जस्, m. A proper name, Rām. 1, 39, 16; 1, 40, 16 Gorr.
असमवायित्व: असमवायित्व असमवायित्व, i. e. अ -समवायिन् + त्व, n. Condition of not being in an intimate relation, Bhāṣāp. 96.
असमावृत्तिक: असमावृत्तिक असमावृत्तिक, i. e. अ -सम्-आवृत्त + इक (? see वृत्), m. A student before he has completed his studies, Man. 11, 157.
असि: असि असि, m. A sword, Rām. 3, 50, 2. -- Cf. Lat. ensis, ἄορ, cf. अक्षन् = अक्षि, and πῖαρ = पीवन्।
असु: असु असु, i. e. 1. अस् + उ, m. plur.  1. The five vital breaths, or airs of the body (cf. Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 9).  2. Life, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 6.  -- Comp. गत- (vb. गम्), adj. lifeless, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 266. अ-गत-, adj. living, ib.
असुर: असुर असुर, i. e. 1. अस् + उर,  I. adj. Eternal, Chr. 290, 2 = Rigv. i. 64, 2.  II. m. An Asura, or demon, Kir. 5, 30.  III. f. री, A female Asura, or demon, MBh. 3, 12203.  -- Comp. देव-,  I. m. pl. the gods and the demons, Rām. 1, 45, 27.  II. adj. 1. referring to the gods and the demons, Rām. 1, 34, 8 Gorr. 2. n. elliptically (supply युद्ध), the war between the gods and the demons, Rām. 3, 53, 8.
असू: असू अ-सू, adj. Sterile, Chr. 296, 3 = Rigv. i. 112, 3.
असूय: असूय असूय (an old denom. based on 2. अस्), Par. Ātm.  1. To de-tract, scorn, MBh. 4, 99.  2. To re-prove, Rājat. 5, 196.  3. To be angry, Mālav. 51, 18.  -- Comp. अन्-असूयन्त्, free from a spirit of detraction, Bhag. 3, 31. Caus. असूयय, To chastise, Nal. 14, 17.  -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To blame, Sāv. 5, 90. असूयाम्, instead of असूये-यम्, MBh. 1, 4377.
असूयक: असूयक असूयक, i. e. असूय + अक, adj., f. यिका, A scorner, Man. 2, 114.  -- Comp. अन्- (i. e. अनसूय + क, see असूया), adj. free from a spirit of de-traction, Nal. 12, 46.
असूया: असूया असूया, i. e. असूय + अ, f.  1. Detraction, Man. 7, 48.  2. Ill-will, Rām. 4, 14, 20.  -- Comp. अन्-असूय,  I. adj. free from a spirit of detraction, Man. 4, 158.  II. f. या, a proper name, Śāk. 9, 7. स-, adv. angrily, Vikr. 30, 14.
असृज्: असृज् असृज्, i. e. असर्-, for 1. अस् + अन्, which is the base of several cases, -ज् (vb. जन्), n. Blood, Pañc. 21, 12. -- With असन्, cf. Lat. san + ies; with असर्, Lat. assir, ἔαρ; with *असन्-ज्, Lat. sanguis.
अस्त: अस्त 1. अस् + त,  I. n. Home.  II. m.  1. Sun-set, Pañc. iii. d. 187; Śiś. 9, 5. The acc. sing. अस्तम्, combined like a prefix, with इ, गम्, या, implies, To set, Daśak. 184, 1.  2. The western moun-tain, behind which the sun is supposed to set, Rām. 4, 37, 4.  IV. n. Death, Kathās. 13, 74; Rājat. 5, 126.  -- Comp. सूर्य-, n. sunset.
अस्तमन: अस्तमन अस्तमन (a syncope of अस्तम्-अयन), n. Sun-set, Pañc. ii. d. 7.
अस्तमय: अस्तमय अस्तमय, i. e. अस्तम्-इ + अ, m. Sun-set, Kir. 5, 35.
अस्तृ: अस्तृ 2. अस् + तृ, m. A shooter, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.
अस्त्र: अस्त्र 2. अस् + त्र, n.  1. A missile weapon, Śāk. 94, 10; an arrow, Vikr. d. 18.  2. A bow, Arj. 8, 2.  -- Comp. इषु-, n. the art of discharging arrows, Chr. 22, 16; 51. 2. कुसुम-, m. the god of Love, Ragh., 7, 58. कृत-, adj. conversant with the use of missile weapons, MBh. 3, 228. दण्ड-, n. the name of a fabulous weapon, Rām. 1, 56, 9. महा-, n. a great missile weapon, Chr. 44, 4.
अस्थि: अस्थि अस्थि; several cases have अस्थन् as their base, n.  1. A bone, Bhartṛ. 2, 9.  2. A kernel, seed, Man. 4, 78. -- Cf. ὀστέον; Lat. os, gen. ossis, for ostis.
अस्थिक: अस्थिक अस्थि + क,  1. n. A small bone, Bhartṛ. 2, 23.  2. A substitute for अस्थि, when latter part of comp. adj., e. g. अन्-, Boneless, Yājñ. 3, 275. दृढ -गुल्फ-शिरा-, adj. Having strong an-cles, nerves, and bones, Rām. 5, 32, 11.
अस्थिदन्तमय: अस्थिदन्तमय अस्थि-दन्त + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of bones and ivory, Man. 5, 121.
अस्थिमत्: अस्थिमन्त् अस्थि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Having bones, Man. 11, 140.
अस्थिमन्त्: अस्थिमन्त् अस्थि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Having bones, Man. 11, 140.
अस्थिमय: अस्थिमय अस्थि-मय, adj., f. यी, Full of bones, Rājat. 5, 272.
अस्मद्: अस्मद् अस्मद्, First person. pronoun,  I; nom. sing. अहम्, plur. वयम्; the bases of the other cases are, म, आव, न, अस्म। -- Cf. ἐγώ, ἐμοῦ, μοῦ, νῶϊ, ἄμμες; Lat. ego, me, nos; Goth. ik, mis, veis, unsis; A.S. ic, më, vit, unc.
अस्मदीय: अस्मदीय अस्मद् + ईय, adj., f. या, Our, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 1.
अस्मयु: अस्मयु अस्मयु, i. e. *अस्मय (a de-nominat. of अस्मद् by य) + उ, adj. Favourable to us, Lass. p. 100, 8 = Rigv. vii. 15, 8.
अस्यवामीय: अस्यवामीय अस्य वाम् + ईय, n. The Vedic hymn beginning with the words अस्य वाम् (Rigv. i. 164), Man. 11, 250.

To say, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 204, 8. -- With प्रति प्रति, To answer. Hit. 10, 2. -- Cf. ἦ = आह।

अह: 1. अह अह, a particle; Certainly, Chr. 287, 4 = Rigv. i. 48, 4.

2. ऽअह -अह, a substitute for अहन्, when part of compound words. Day, e. g. अघ-, n. A day of impurity, Man. 5, 84. अनिर्दशाह, i. e. अ-निस्-दशन्-, adj. f. हा, Not out of the ten days (of impurity which follow birth or death), Man. 8, 242. एकादशाह, i. e. एकादशन् -अह, adj. Lasting eleven days, MBh. 13, 4938. एकाह, i. e. एक-अह, m. One day, Man. 5, 59. कतिपयाह, i. e. क-तिपय-, Some day, Chr. 52, 19 (sing); Pañc. 9, 6 (plur). क्षपाह, i. e. क्ष-पा-, A day and night, Man. 1, 68. त्रि-,  I. n. Three days, Man. 4, 110.  II. adj. Lasting three days, Rām. 1, 13, 43. दशाह, i. e. दशन्-, n. An interval of ten days, Man. 5, 59. पञ्चाह, i. e. पञ्चन्-, n. A period of five days, Kathās. 41, 26. पुण्य-, n. A holy day, Chr. 25, 20. सप्ताह, i. e. सप्तन्-, n. Seven days, a week.
अहङ्कार: अहंकार अहंकार, i. e. अहम्-कार, m.  1. Conceiving objects with the notion that they refer to one's own self, egotism, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 3.  2. Pride, Rām. 4, 6, 22.  3. Self-con-ceit, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 4; arrogance, Rājat. 5, 234.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. free from selfishness, MBh. 15, 882.
अहंकार: अहंकार अहंकार, i. e. अहम्-कार, m.  1. Conceiving objects with the notion that they refer to one's own self, egotism, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 3.  2. Pride, Rām. 4, 6, 22.  3. Self-con-ceit, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 4; arrogance, Rājat. 5, 234.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. free from selfishness, MBh. 15, 882.
अहङ्कृत: अहंकृत अहंकृत, i. e. अहम्-कृत, adj.  1. Selfish, Bhag. 18, 17.  2. Proud, Yājñ. 3, 151.  3. Arrogant, Brāhmaṇav. 2, 11.  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. not arrogant, Man. 9, 335. निस्-, adj. 1. Impersonal, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 8. 2. Not selfish, Bhāg. P. 3, 32, 6.
अहंकृत: अहंकृत अहंकृत, i. e. अहम्-कृत, adj.  1. Selfish, Bhag. 18, 17.  2. Proud, Yājñ. 3, 151.  3. Arrogant, Brāhmaṇav. 2, 11.  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. not arrogant, Man. 9, 335. निस्-, adj. 1. Impersonal, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 8. 2. Not selfish, Bhāg. P. 3, 32, 6.
अहङ्कृति: अहंकृति अहंकृति, i. e. अहम्-कृ + ति, f.  1. Selfishness, Bhartṛ. 3, 95.  2. Pride, Rājat. 5, 481.
अहंकृति: अहंकृति अहंकृति, i. e. अहम्-कृ + ति, f.  1. Selfishness, Bhartṛ. 3, 95.  2. Pride, Rājat. 5, 481.
अहन्: अहन् अहन्; several cases have as their base अहस्, which is used also as former part of compound words, n. A day, Śiś. 9, 23. Ved. अहा for अहानि, Chr. 289, 7 = Rigv. i. 50, 7.
अहम्: अहम् अहम् (see अस्मद्). Former part of many compound words, imply-ing the first person, e. g. अहंकार, see above; अहम्-पूर्व, see पूर्व।
अहर्पति: अहर्पति अहर्पति, i. e. अहन्-पति, m. The sun, Ragh. 10, 55.
अहल्या: अहल्या अहल्या, f. The wife of Gautama, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 10.
अहह: अहह अहह, interj.  1. of sur-prise, Bhartṛ. 2, 28;  2. of pain, Bhartṛ. 2, 29;  3. of pleasure, Vikr. 65, 11;  4. of calling, Hit. 12, 3.
अहार्यत्व: अहार्यत्व अ-हार्य + त्व (vb. हृ), n. Condition of not being easily taken away, Hit. Pr. d. 4.
अहि: अहि अहि, i. e. probably *अंह् + इ (cf. अंहस्), A snake, Kir. 5, 47.  -- Comp. अन्ध-, m. a kind of snake.  -- Cf. ἔχις; Lat. anguis; probably also ὄϕις.
अहिर्ब्रध्न: अहिर्ब्रध्न अहिर्ब्रध्न, i. e. अहि + स् -ब्रध्न, m. The name of a Rudra or deity, MBh. 5, 3899.
अहीन: अहीन अहीन, m. The name of a sacrifice, Man. 11, 197.
अहो: अहो अहो, interj.  1. of calling, Pañc. 45, 12;  2. of grief, Pañc. 21, 3;  3. of regret, Śāk. d. 35;  4. of contempt, Pañc. Pr. d. 8;  5. of surprise, Pañc. 76, 24;  6. of praise, Hit. 17, 5.
अहोरात्र: अहोरात्र अहोरात्र, i. e. अहन्-रात्र, m. and n. A day of twenty-four hours or thirty मुहूर्तस्, Man. 1, 64.
अह्न: ऽअह्न -अह्न, i. e. अहन् + अ, A substi-tute for अहन् in the latter part of some compound words, e. g. पराह्न and पराहन्, i. e. पर-, m. The after-noon. पूर्व-, and प्र-, m. The fore-noon, Man. 2, 256. मध्य-, m. Noon, Lass. 73, 18. साय-, m. Evening.
अह्नाय: अह्नाय अह्नाय, (properly dat. sing. of the preceding), adv. Soon, Ragh. 5, 71.
